title: Response Authority / Executor Closure
rootCause: The pipeline factory accepted a complete dependency bundle but judgeIntegratedResponse still called a module-level responseExecutor bound to the default responseSemanticAuthority; source identity semantics were also hardwired to the default singleton.
changes: Response pipeline dependencies now require the existing response semantic authority.
Source identity semantics are obtained from the selected response semantic authority, avoiding a parallel identity dependency slot.
Added a factory for the existing response semantic authority with explicit source identity semantics.
Added an executor factory whose execute and projection members derive from the exact authority supplied.
The integrated pipeline constructs and uses its executor from its dependency contract authority.
Response pipeline contract version advanced from 26 to 27.
Exported the authority/executor factories and the complete dependency composition through the upstream public index.
